items.title: Bitcoin selloff drives major crypto losses
items.summary: Bitcoin fell to about $62,112, its lowest level since July, before recovering near $64,844. Ether, XRP and Solana also declined sharply, while roughly $2 billion in crypto positions were liquidated over 24 hours.[4]

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds from intraday low
items.summary: Bitcoin recovered from approximately $62,006 to $64,820, while Ethereum climbed back above $1,800 after a sharp market decline.[2]

items.title: Cross-border blockchain FX settlement tested
items.summary: The Bank of England, Monetary Authority of Singapore and Bank of Thailand tested Project Meridian FX APAC, using blockchain and conventional systems for cross-border foreign-exchange settlement.[5]

items.title: Telegram activates more than one million self-custodial wallets
items.summary: Telegram founder Pavel Durov said more than one million self-custodial wallets were activated on the messaging platform within 48 hours.[6]

items.title: USDC Treasury mints $250 million on Solana
items.summary: USDC Treasury reportedly minted 250 million USDC on the Solana blockchain, representing approximately $250 million in newly issued stablecoins.[5]

items.title: Hyperliquid repurchases and burns HYPE tokens
items.summary: Hyperliquid reportedly repurchased and destroyed 47,700 HYPE tokens worth about $3.17 million, bringing cumulative token destruction to approximately 50.59 million HYPE.[5]

ai_news.query: What are the most important artificial intelligence and machine learning news and developments from the past 24 hours? Include new model releases, company announcements, research breakthroughs, and industry trends.

items.title: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
items.summary: Anthropic announced upgraded Claude models focused on coding, reasoning, and scientific research. The company also reported additional Claude product launches and updates, including Claude Meetings and Claude Sheets.[1][5]

items.title: Google Gemini 4 Carbon reportedly leads MathArena benchmark
items.summary: Google’s Gemini 4 Carbon reportedly moved ahead of OpenAI’s GPT-6.1 Sol on the MathArena mathematics benchmark, while Anthropic’s Claude Fable 5.2 placed second. The reported performance advantage comes with substantially higher inference costs.[4][10]

items.title: Runway releases Praxis-1 robot-control model
items.summary: Runway released the trained weights and inference code for Praxis-1, enabling developers and researchers to use and further train the robot-control model.[2]

items.title: Researchers demonstrate weight-space programming
items.summary: Researchers reportedly demonstrated a method for directly editing neural-network weights to change another model’s behavior without conventional retraining. One cited experiment substantially improved a small model’s mathematics score after modifying a very small fraction of its weights.[1]

items.title: Google expands Gemini 4 and AI infrastructure lineup
items.summary: Google reportedly announced Gemini 4 models, new TPU systems, robotics updates, and additional DeepMind research projects during a concentrated series of releases. The announcements target coding, AI agents, robotics, encrypted processing, and scientific applications.[8]

items.title: AI infrastructure demand raises concern about future CPU shortages
items.summary: Industry reporting says accelerating AI infrastructure deployment is increasing demand for central processors in addition to GPUs. Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan reportedly warned that supply constraints could persist through 2028.[10]

gaming.query: What are the most notable video game and gaming industry news from the past 24 hours? Include game releases, announcements, esports, and industry developments.

items.title: Riot unveils League of Legends: New Dawn
items.summary: Riot Games announced a major League of Legends overhaul at the 2026 World Championship finals, featuring a modernized client, refreshed Summoner’s Rift visuals, gameplay changes, and new champion experiences. Riot also announced future international event locations, including Worlds 2027 in Japan and South Korea.

items.title: Bilibili Gaming wins the 2026 League of Legends World Championship
items.summary: China’s Bilibili Gaming won the League of Legends World Championship, with the final taking place alongside Riot’s announcements for the game’s 2027 update and future esports calendar.

items.title: Valve expands SteamOS hardware support
items.summary: Valve released SteamOS 3.10 Preview, adding broader support for AMD and NVIDIA graphics hardware and improvements intended to increase device compatibility and stability.

items.title: Logitech gives employees a paid gaming day ahead of GTA VI
items.summary: Logitech announced Logi Game Day, giving more than 7,000 employees a paid day off to play video games. The initiative arrives ahead of Grand Theft Auto VI’s scheduled November 19 release and reflects the anticipated scale of the launch.

items.title: Star Citizen and Squadron 42 funding surpasses $1 billion
items.summary: Cloud Imperium Games’ combined crowdfunding total for Star Citizen and Squadron 42 reportedly passed $1 billion. The studio also released footage from a community hands-on event and teased a December 16 announcement.

items.title: Nintendo releases Zelda: Ocarina of Time update for Switch 2
items.summary: Nintendo deployed day-one update 1.1.1 for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on Switch 2, adding Zelda Notes companion support and addressing launch issues.
